question: Did you have caffeine after 2 pm?
questionRu: Был кофеин после 14:00?
tip: Late coffee. Caffeine close to bedtime can affect sleep, even if you don't notice it. Compare nights after late coffee.
source: Drake et al., J Clin Sleep Med 2013

question: Did you get up at about your usual time?
questionRu: Подъём сегодня был в пределах часа от обычного (в выходные тоже)?
tip: Same wake-up time. Irregular sleep and wake times are linked to poorer sleep. See whether a steadier routine makes a difference for you.
source: Bei et al., Sleep Med Rev 2016

question: Did worries or racing thoughts keep you awake in bed at night?
questionRu: Этой ночью в кровати крутились мысли и тревоги и мешали уснуть?
tip: Worries at bedtime. Stress and worries at bedtime have been linked to poorer sleep. Notice how your nights go after restless evenings.

question: Did you get outdoor daylight before noon?
questionRu: Был дневной свет на улице до полудня?
tip: Morning daylight. Earlier daylight exposure has been linked to some aspects of sleep. Notice whether nights after mornings outdoors feel different.

question: Did you sleep 7+ hours?
questionRu: Этой ночью сна было 7+ часов?
tip: Sleep and mood. How you sleep and how you feel the next day are closely connected. Compare your mood after nights when you felt you had enough sleep.
source: Triantafillou et al., JMIR Mental Health 2019

question: Did you spend time on your hobby?
questionRu: Занимался(ась) сегодня своим хобби?
tip: Time for a hobby. Making time for something you enjoy may support your well-being. Notice how days with a hobby feel.

question: Did you spend time in a park, by water or among trees?
questionRu: Сегодня было время в парке, у воды или среди деревьев?
tip: Time in nature. Spending time around natural surroundings has been linked to better mood. Notice how days outdoors feel for you.

question: Did you notice something good?
questionRu: Заметил(а) сегодня что-то хорошее?
tip: Noticing good moments. Taking a moment to appreciate good things may give a small boost to well-being. See if you notice a difference.
source: Davis et al., J Couns Psychol 2016

question: Did you drink more than 1.5 litres of water?
questionRu: Сегодня выпил(а) больше 1.5 литра воды?
tip: Water through the day. Even mild dehydration can be linked to tiredness and headaches. Notice how you feel on days when you drink less water.

question: Were you exhausted most of the day?
questionRu: Большую часть дня чувствовал(а) себя выжатым(ой)?
tip: Drained days. Sleep, stress and daily demands can all contribute to tiredness. Tracking low-energy days may help you notice patterns.

question: Did you nap during the day?
questionRu: Спал(а) сегодня днём?
tip: Daytime naps. The timing of a daytime nap may affect sleep later that night. See how nights after naps compare.
source: Mograss et al., J Sleep Res 2022

question: Did you drink any alcohol?
questionRu: Пил(а) ли сегодня алкоголь (даже один бокал)?
tip: Alcohol in the evening. Alcohol may make it easier to fall asleep but can disrupt sleep later in the night. Compare the mornings after.
source: Ebrahim et al., Alcohol Clin Exp Res 2013

question: Did you have 4 or more coffees, strong teas or energy drinks?
questionRu: Сегодня было 4+ чашки кофе, крепкого чая или энергетика?
tip: Several coffees a day. Higher doses of caffeine may increase anxiety for some people. Notice whether days with several coffees feel different.

question: Did you skip a meal or go 5+ hours without food in the day?
questionRu: Сегодня был пропущенный приём пищи или 5+ часов без еды (не во сне)?
tip: Skipped meals and headaches. Some people with migraine report skipped meals as a possible trigger. Notice whether missed meals and headaches coincide for you.

question: Did you have a big dinner late in the evening?
questionRu: Был плотный ужин меньше чем за 2 часа до сна?
tip: Meals before bed. Eating close to bedtime can make heartburn worse for some people. Notice whether the timing of your evening meal matters.

question: Did you walk 7,000+ steps?
questionRu: Прошёл(прошла) сегодня 7000 шагов или больше?
tip: Walking more. Higher daily step counts have been linked to lower long-term health risks. Notice how often you make time to walk more.
source: Ding et al., Lancet Public Health 2025

question: Did you do a real workout?
questionRu: Была сегодня настоящая тренировка (зал, бег, спорт, йога)?
tip: Workouts and mood. Physical activity is often followed by a more positive mood. Notice how you feel on days when you exercise.

question: Was the day's workout a real load — not just a walk?
questionRu: Была настоящая тренировка с нагрузкой — не «прогулка»?
tip: Hard workouts and sleep. How hard and how late you exercise may affect your sleep. Notice how you sleep after more intense workout days.

question: Did you use screens in the hour before sleep?
questionRu: Был(а) в телефоне или у экрана в последний час перед сном?
tip: Screens before sleep. Screen use before bed has been linked to poorer sleep, though cause and effect aren't clear. Look for patterns in your own nights.
source: Brautsch et al., Sleep Med Rev 2023

question: Did you spend more than an hour on social media?
questionRu: Сегодня в соцсетях больше часа?
tip: Time on social media. Limiting social media use has shown small benefits for well-being in some studies. See if less scrolling makes a difference for you.
source: RTI: The effects of social media restriction (32 trials)

question: Did you spend too long in news or sports feeds?
questionRu: Сегодня много залипал(а) в новости / спорт?
tip: Too much news. News you experience as negative may be linked to a lower mood. Notice how you feel after following the news.
source: de Hoog & Verboon, Br J Psychol 2020

question: Was the day stressful?
questionRu: Сегодня был стресс?
tip: Stress that lingers. A stressful day can still affect how you feel the following day. Notice what tends to follow your harder days.

question: Did constant interruptions, messages or meetings break up your day?
questionRu: Сегодня день рвали постоянные сообщения, звонки или встречи?
tip: Constant interruptions. In one experiment, interruptions made people work faster but also feel more stressed and frustrated. Notice how interrupted days feel for you.

question: Did you feel completely drained after work?
questionRu: Сегодня после работы совсем не осталось сил?
tip: Drained after work. A small study found that some parents withdrew more from their children after stressful workdays. Notice how work stress affects your evenings.

question: Did you meditate or breathe slowly?
questionRu: Медитировал(а) или спокойно дышал(а) 5 минут и больше?
tip: A few calm minutes. Mindfulness meditation apps have shown small reductions in stress in studies. Notice whether days with meditation feel calmer for you.
source: Gál et al., J Affect Disord 2021

question: Did you see friends in person?
questionRu: Сегодня была встреча с друзьями вживую?
tip: Seeing people in person. Positive in-person interactions have been linked to less loneliness. Notice how you feel after spending time with people.
source: Silva et al., J Soc Pers Relat 2023

question: Did you have a real, open conversation with someone (not small talk)?
questionRu: Сегодня был настоящий, открытый разговор с кем-то (не просто болтовня)?
tip: Real conversations. Meaningful conversations have been linked to greater well-being and connection. Notice how days with deeper conversations feel.

question: Did you fight with your partner?
questionRu: Сегодня была серьёзная ссора с партнёром?
tip: Arguments after bad nights. Poor sleep has been linked to more conflict and difficulties resolving disagreements. Notice how conversations go after restless nights.
source: Gordon & Chen, Soc Psychol Personal Sci 2014

question: Did someone share the childcare with you — partner, family, a sitter, a friend?
questionRu: Сегодня кто-то разделил заботу о детях — партнёр, родные, няня, друзья?
tip: Help with the kids. Parenting burnout has been linked to high demands and insufficient support. Notice whether days with help feel different.
source: Mikolajczak et al., Curr Dir Psychol Sci 2023

question: Did you take a painkiller or migraine pill for a headache?
questionRu: Сегодня пришлось пить обезболивающее или таблетку от мигрени?
tip: Painkiller days. Frequent use of headache medication can sometimes contribute to recurring headaches. Tracking medication days may help you notice a pattern worth discussing with a doctor.

question: Did your neck hurt or feel stiff?
questionRu: Сегодня болела или затекала шея?
tip: Neck pain and migraine. Neck pain is often reported around migraine attacks. Sometimes it may be an early symptom rather than a trigger.
source: Goadsby et al., Eur J Neurol 2021 (Migraine Buddy data)

question: Did you have your period (any bleeding)?
questionRu: Сегодня были месячные (хоть немного)?
tip: Headaches and periods. For some people with migraine, attacks are more common just before and during the first days of a period.

question: Did your stomach hurt?
questionRu: Сегодня болел живот?
tip: Stress and your stomach. In a study of people with irritable bowel syndrome, stress and symptoms often increased together. Notice whether stress and stomach discomfort coincide for you.
source: Yunusova et al., Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 2026

question: Did you smoke a cigarette or vape?
questionRu: Сегодня было курение — сигарета или вейп?
tip: Nicotine and sleep. Evening nicotine use has been linked to more disrupted sleep. Notice how nights after nicotine use compare.

question: Did you put things off most of the day?
questionRu: Сегодня в основном тянул(а) и откладывал(а)?
tip: Putting things off. Tasks that feel unpleasant or difficult are often easier to postpone. Notice what your procrastination days have in common.

question: Did you have much less caffeine than usual, or none?
questionRu: Сегодня кофеина было гораздо меньше обычного или не было совсем?
tip: Less coffee than usual. Suddenly reducing caffeine can bring headaches and tiredness for a few days. Notice how you feel when your intake changes.
